paragraphs.text: The seaport of Benalia City is the capital of Benalia in the Domains of Dominaria . Since the Mending it is sometimes referred to as New Benalia , or occasionally as the City of the Seven . Located on the empire's northwestern peninsula, it straddles the large, languid Reitmar River .
In the central square of the city stand the Seven Pillars that mark the accord among the seven houses:
Clan Avenant (replacing the extinct Clan Ternsev )

The houses use a rotating system that allows each clan to rule a different division - army, navy, treasury, and so on - each year in a seven-year cycle. This has continued for ages, and its clumsiness was overlooked as the clans couldn't agree on another ruling method. The Council of Seven meets in the city's Grand Hall, which is warded against magic and teleportation.

The city had a population exceeding 200,000 and was the largest city in the Domains . The prevailing religion was the Church of Angelfire , of which over one-fifth of all Benalkin identified as members. This was due to its similarity to the Church of Serra , whose worship of the planeswalker Serra was condemned in Benalia.
During the Phyrexian Invasion , Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers. When the invasion peaked in 4205 AR , Benalia City was razed, and its people scattered.
Benalia City was slowly rebuilt, and by 4307 AR, travelers ventured from as far away as Otaria to join in the efforts to recreate the once great city.
During the era of the Time Spiral crisis , Benalia City was besieged by slivers , and it became a salt-choked ruin.

After the Mending , the city was rebuilt as New Benalia, using the white limestone of fallen buildings. With the influx of refugees from Serra's Realm , the Church of Serra regained legitimacy. The gates to this new Benalia City are impressive, constructed of the magical Benalish stained glass. They were well over four stories high, set in soaring gray stone walls topped with narrow towers and arches. In the center of the city rise spires of gleaming white limestone, much of it quarried from the fallen buildings of Old Benalia. These towers hold the city residences of the seven great houses, government, and administration. The port quarter does business with merchants from all over the world, and the Benalish navy maintains a large dry dock. The floating buildings of the Church of Serra dot the sky above the city.
